score_document_coherence_with_momentum: use MomentumCoherenceProcessor to score a list of documents and return coherence values as a numpy array
score_next_sentences_momentum_coherence: use MomentumCoherenceProcessor.score_next_sentences to compute per-sentence coherence differences between ground truth and predicted documents
score_contrastive_perplexity: use PrefixContrastiveSentencePerplexityScorer to compute per-token inter-sentence mutual information scores for a list of documents
score_next_sentences_contrastive_perplex: use PrefixContrastiveSentencePerplexityScorer.score_next_sentences to compute per-sentence mutual information scores between ground truth and predicted documents
score_prefix_suffix_pairs: use PrefixContrastiveSentencePerplexityScorer._score_prefix_suffix_pairs to compute mutual information and suffix lengths for paired prefix and suffix strings
